ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in computer accessories right now than adding another TV streaming device.
ItemID: NA; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB - Up to 1050MB/s - USB 3.2 External Solid State Drive, Blue (MU-PC500H/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for portable storage and moving files between my computers and projects.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Bluetooth Headphones, 40H Playtime, Hi-Res Audio, Deep Bass, Memory Foam Ear Cups, for Travel, Home Office; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these as a wireless alternative to my wired headphones, especially for listening at my desk.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display does not address the computer setup and accessory needs I am focused on.
ItemID: NA; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would choose the over-ear headphones on this page before trying in-ear earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a current home surveillance project that would make this bundle useful.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in over-ear listening, and I have no clear reason to choose these for my current setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Seagate Exos X18 16TB Enterprise HDD - CMR 3.5 Inch Hyperscale SATA 6Gb/s, 7200 RPM, 512e and 4Kn FastFormat, Low Latency with Enhanced Caching (ST16000NM000J); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a 16TB internal enterprise drive; portable storage fits my projects better.
